title: Bounded formal-model adapter
description: A reviewed direct TLC command with explicit worker, depth, model, configuration, version, and deadline bounds.
assumptions: The separately installed tlc launcher is pinned to TLA+ Tools 1.8.0 and its version probe has the exact reviewed output.
The checked-in configuration names every invariant and finite constant required for the selected model.
A completed bounded exploration is evidence about the declared TLA+ model only, not proof that an implementation refines it.
The adapter invokes the reviewed command offline and never retains TLC output in AWQ evidence.

contracts.limitation: TLC explores only the declared model within one worker, depth 1000, its finite constants, and a 300 second deadline; this does not prove implementation refinement.
contracts.remediation: Rerun the exact native TLC argv for private diagnostics, then repair the model, configuration, bound, or implementation correspondence outside AWQ evidence.
